vendors.siteNotes: Active. The site is JavaScript-rendered and was read in a browser. It lists no happy hour; the happy hour below is third-party (King of Happy Hour). The 'Never Too Late' listing shows Sep 30, but its description says Sunday Sep 13. The Oct 5 Monday Mamis listing shows an end time of '10:30 AM', likely a typo. November dates also exist on the site. Instagram could not be loaded. IG adds Sabados En Fuego (weekly Saturday Latin night, returning Oct 3) and several dated events the site does not list.
